connector.name: Outscraper MCP Server
connector.registryDescription: Outscraper MCP business discovery, Maps intelligence, enrichment, reviews, and contact data.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.outscraper.com over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package outscraper-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the outscraper account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: OUTSCRAPER_API_KEY
env.description: Your Outscraper API key. Required for authenticated tool calls in stdio mode and for non-cloud HTTP deployments.

env.name: CLOUD_SERVICE
env.description: Set to true to require the API key from Authorization or X-API-KEY headers in HTTP mode

env.name: HTTP_STREAMABLE_SERVER
env.description: Set to true to run the server over stateless Streamable HTTP instead of stdio

env.name: SSE_LOCAL
env.description: Set to true to run a local stateful HTTP/SSE mode with session management

env.name: HTTP_STATEFUL_SERVER
env.description: Alternative flag for enabling stateful HTTP session mode

env.name: HOST
env.description: HTTP bind host used when HTTP_STREAMABLE_SERVER=true

env.name: PORT
env.description: HTTP bind port used when HTTP_STREAMABLE_SERVER=true
